name: Alsodux (Spain)
description: Five horizontal stripes of green, white, red, white and blue, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Alsodux (a clock tower on green and a flower above a mountain).
history: Alsodux adopted its arms and flag officially on 5 March 2020; the flag is a rectangular cloth of proportions 3:2 divided into five horizontal stripes, the central one red, the adjoining ones white, the upper green and the lower blue, with the municipal arms at the centre.

features.role: Alsodux arms — clock tower, flower and mountain
